physics_goals.quote: The SPD is planned to operate as a universal facility for comprehensive study of the unpolarized and polarized gluon content of the nucleon at large Bjorken-x
physics_goals.value: Study the unpolarised and polarised gluon content of the nucleon at large Bjorken-x with charmonia, open charm and prompt photons

summary.plain: The Spin Physics Detector is a planned experiment at JINR's NICA collider to study the spin structure of the proton and deuteron, especially how gluons carry spin, using polarised proton and deuteron beams colliding at up to 27 GeV.
summary.technical: Spin Physics Detector: universal detector for the second NICA interaction point measuring charmonia, open charm and prompt photons in polarised p-p, d-d and p-d collisions at up to 27 GeV and luminosity up to 1e32 cm^-2 s^-1 to access gluon helicity, Sivers, Boer-Mulders and transversity distributions; CDR 2021, TDR 2024; magnet yoke contract pending (June 2026).
